purpose: A music party app: guests join a room from their phone and vote on what plays next. Built for house parties. The host controls the Spotify playback; guests only vote.

pitfalls.note: Refresh tokens live in .data/tokens.json and are written on every refresh. Never log that file, and never commit it — it is gitignored for a reason.
Socket.IO rooms must be re-joined after a server restart. If votes stop syncing, the client likely connected before the room existed.
HOST_PASSWORD must be set in .env or the server refuses to start. There is no default, by design.
Async error handlers are not auto-caught like Express 4. Wrap route handlers or errors vanish silently.
